items.label: ✓ Total Protection
items.value: Featuring ripstop PU coated fabric, the cover is designed to protect dining table & chairs and furniture set from sun, rain, snow, dirt, animal hair, bird poop etc. Fits up to 180W x 96D x 36H inches

items.label: ✓Stronger & Waterproof
items.value: The ripstop fabric makes the cover 3X as strong at a fraction of the weight. The cover remains soft in low temperatures and demonstrates superior tear resistance.

items.label: ✓Fit & Secure
items.value: Cinch the cover in the middle. Tie it down with the click-close straps at the corners & the long sides and the grommets at the hem. They ensure a tight fit, prevent the cover from getting torn, and keep the cover in place.

items.label: ✓ Easy to Use
items.value: Durable medium weight cover with two reinforced handles make it easy to put on and take off. Two air vents reduce inside condensation and wind lofting. The cover can be put away in its own storage bag when not in use.

items.label: ✓ Cover for All
items.value: Great gift idea for special occasions, during the holiday season, birthdays, and more. Putting an object underneath can prevent water pooling. If you have any questions, reach out to us and we will get you covered.
